title: Mexican Governor Maru Hands Out Gifts and Rivers of Public Money to Media and Famous Journalists From Mexico City
author: Arturo Daen
content:
_This article by[Arturo Daen](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/arturo-daen/)
originally appeared in the [October 25, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4891518/maru-reparte-regalos-y-rios-de-
dinero-publico-a-medios-y-periodistas-famosos-de-cdmx/), an independent
Mexican digital news outlet._

**Mexico City, October 25 (SinEmbargo).—** To confront criticism and attempt
to polish their public image, the state Government of Maru Campos and that of
the National Action Party (PAN) in the municipality of Chihuahua have racked
up millions in spending of public resources on official advertising, events,
the hiring of artists, influencers and media personalities, as well as the
purchase of gifts.

Campos's administration has so far allocated at least **2.6 billion pesos to
advertise itself** on television, radio and the internet, with contracts for
**Televisa** for at least 96.8 million pesos, according to data from its
Communications office, and for **_TV Azteca_** for **89 million** ; in
addition to paying 21.7 million pesos [to
_Latinus_](https://contrataciones.chihuahua.gob.mx/licitaciones/35039/) for
its propaganda (including a contract in 2024 for 12.7 million and another for
9 million); 2.3 million to the company [Alazraki Bross
TV](https://contrataciones.chihuahua.gob.mx/licitaciones/32411/), of
_[Atypical Te Ve](https://atypicaltv.com/)_ , and 2 million to the news site
of [Joaquín López
Dóriga](https://contrataciones.chihuahua.gob.mx/licitaciones/44370/), among
other media outlets.

![One of the payments to the company behind Latinus, in 2024 for 12.7
million](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/02-latinus-
payment.jpg)One of the payments to the company behind Latinus, in 2024 for
12.7 million. Document: PNT

In addition, according to documents [from the Public
Account](https://chihuahua.gob.mx/info/indice-cuenta-publica-estatal) and from
Chihuahua's Secretariat of Finance, this year its **Public Relations
Coordination** will reach spending of **433 million pesos** on the payment of
**meals, gifts for business people and politicians, food baskets and even
tamales.**

For example, spending of **1.317 million pesos** by the state Government was
found for the **purchase of more than 1,500**[**ties and
scarves**](https://contrataciones.chihuahua.gob.mx/licitaciones/26704/)**from
brands such as**[**Pineda
Covalín**](https://contrataciones.chihuahua.gob.mx/licitaciones/25269/)**,**
with “elements alluding to the state of Chihuahua,” to give away, promote the
cultural heritage of the state and “foster” the relationship of the state
Executive “with business and social sectors and various levels of government.”

![One of the documents showing the purchase of ties by the Government of Maru
Campos](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/03-ties-
purchase.jpg)One of the documents showing the purchase of ties by the
Government of Maru Campos. Document: PNT

SinEmbargo's **Data Unit** also found spending of 440,000 pesos by the
Government of Maru Campos on the purchase of desk **lamps** “with an electric
wax warmer” and of 800 **acrylic boxes** in 2022 with walnuts and an “ornament
representative of the state of Chihuahua,” to give to business people and
other social or political actors, and supposedly thereby exalt the culture of
the state and its artistic expressions.

The Culture Institute of the Municipality of Chihuahua, meanwhile, [**paid in
July 2024**](https://contrataciones.chihuahua.gob.mx/licitaciones/38763/)**the
host Adela Micha 1.5 million pesos** for a lecture at the event “Referencia
norte 2024,” according to the contract available on the National Transparency
Platform.

For the same event it made a payment of 255,000 pesos for a talk by the
influencer **Farid Dieck** , and this year it allocated 295,000 pesos for a
lecture by the actor and also content creator **Alan Estrada.**

![Contract for 1.5 million in favor of Adela
Micha](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/04-adela-micha-
contract.jpg)Contract for 1.5 million in favor of Adela Micha in 2024.
Document: PNT

## **Other Media Personalities and Artists Hired by Chihuahua**

Last January, the Municipal Water and Sanitation Board of Chihuahua signed a
contract for 2.95 million pesos to hold the ChiguAgua Fest event, whose
speakers included the host **Chumel Torres** of _Radio Fórmula_.

The contract signed with Luis Felipe Nevárez Portillo mentions that the amount
included the “booking and management of the local and national talent that
will participate in the forum,” although the specific payment allocated to
Chumel is not detailed.

![Promotional ad for ChiguAgua Fest and its special
guests](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/05-chiguagua-
fest.jpg)Promotional ad for the so-called ChiguAgua Fest and its special
guests. Photo: Meta

For hosting the event “Referencia Norte 2024,” the Culture Institute of the
Municipality of Chihuahua paid 232,000 pesos to the media personality **Maca
Carriedo** , and 104,000 for the production of a podcast.

The same body, the Culture Institute, [signed
contracts](https://contrataciones.chihuahua.gob.mx/licitaciones/38866/) for
the performance of international artists such as **Ricky Martin** , allocating
13 million pesos for the setup and teardown of production, dressing rooms,
sound and lighting; while, [according to the site
ZonaFree](https://zonafree.mx/2026/06/18/concierto-de-ricky-martin-costo-mas-
de-41-millones/), the Secretariat of Culture of the Government of Maru Campos
signed a contract for 30.8 million for the concert in 2024.

The records of the Culture Institute of the Municipality of Chihuahua also
show payments of 20 million for an Alejandro Sanz concert, and of 2 million
for a concert by the singer Natalia Jiménez, among other artists.

## **Official Advertising With La Saga and an Agency That Promoted the PRI**

The contracts available on the National Transparency Platform show that the
Government of Maru Campos has paid 26 million pesos to the agency Limón
Publicistas of Juan Carlos Limón, [the most recent payment for 17
million](https://contrataciones.chihuahua.gob.mx/licitaciones/42982/), for the
production of its institutional campaigns. Limón was Enrique Peña Nieto's go-
to publicist and also took part in marketing work for other PRI politicians,
such as the former governors Roberto Borge Angulo, of Quintana Roo, and
Rodrigo Medina de la Cruz, of Nuevo León.

With the company Conducción de Telecomunicaciones, behind Adela Micha's site
_La Saga_ , a contract was found in 2022 for 2.3 million pesos; one with
_Nexos_ , for 1.2 million; contracts for 8.2 million with the companies
Periódico Digital Sendero and Now New Media, and for 25.9 million pesos with
_Excélsior_ and Grupo Imagen.

As for Carlos Loret de Mola's _Latinus_ , official advertising
[contracts](https://contrataciones.chihuahua.gob.mx/licitaciones/35039/) with
the company BCG Limited Consulting total 21.7 million pesos, split between a
contract for 12.7 million in 2024 and another for 9 million this year.

The organization Article 19 placed **Chihuahua among the five states with the
highest social communication spending,** as it allocated 0.6 percent of its
entire budget to that work.

“46.6 percent of the total budget accrued in this area was granted to 8.3
percent of the roster of suppliers that received more than 10 million pesos in
contracts. The country's two main television networks were the ones that
received the largest amounts from this PAN government: TV Azteca S.A.B. de
C.V. with 37.62 million pesos and Televisa,” [Article 19
stated.](https://articulo19.org/wp-
content/uploads/2025/10/A19_2025_PublicidadOficial2024-1.pdf)

## **Tamales, Home Appliances, Food Baskets…**

In the review of data from the Public Relations Coordination of Maru's
Government, a contract was found for 183,000 pesos in 2022 for the purchase of
electronic devices and home appliances that the Campos Government would give
away at a “megaposada” in the Vistas Cerro Grande neighborhood of Chihuahua.
The contract details the acquisition of 10 electric stoves, 6 steam irons and
10 water tanks, among other items.

The purchase, the contract stated, would be to promote Mexican traditions,
with a message of peace and harmony, and so that people would feel “the
support of the governmental powers.”

Also in 2022, in December, the state administration bought 45 food baskets for
111,243 pesos, which the Governor would hand out in the municipality of
Sisoguichi.

Meanwhile, in January 2023, ahead of Candlemas Day and a celebration in the
municipality of Chihuahua, the Public Relations Coordination bought 5,000
tamales for 107,300 pesos, “promoting the closeness of the Executive with the
State of Chihuahua, with the citizenry.”

## **Maru 's Communications and PR Bought Cars From a Family Business**

The Public Relations Coordination of the Government of Maru Campos bought
three current-year pickup trucks in 2023 from the company Tu Mejor Agencia
Automotriz, for **1.424 million pesos** , to “make its functions more
efficient and guarantee the fulfillment of its responsibilities, with the
equipment of new vehicles that will help with them,” as the contract reads.

That dealership, [as
documented](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4855808/desde-2023-campos-ha-dado-a-su-
familia-politica-194-millones-de-pesos-en-contratos/) by journalist Dulce
Olvera, of the **SinEmbargo** Data Unit, was founded by Maru Campos's former
husband, **Víctor Manuel Cruz Russek (1950-2025)** , and his children are
partners.

In the case of the Social Communication Coordination, in 2023 it bought from
Tu Mejor Agencia Automotriz a current-year pickup truck worth 484,900 pesos,
and two sedans for 539,000 pesos.

![Contract between the company Tu Mejor Agencia Automotriz and the Government
of Chihuahua](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/06-car-
dealership-contract.jpg)Contract between the company Tu Mejor Agencia
